items.title: AI-Powered Briefing Platform
items.summary: A 16,000-line, 11-step platform that transforms the agency briefing process — from client intake to Figma-ready specs, powered by AI and automation.
items.challenge: The agency's web design briefing process was entirely manual — designers spent hours gathering client information, extracting brand identity, and writing specs from scratch. The process was slow, inconsistent, and hard to scale.
items.solution: Built a complete 11-step guided briefing system with 243 visual templates and 26 component categories (~16,000 lines of code). The system automatically analyzes the client's existing website using Puppeteer, extracts visual identity, and uses Google Gemini to generate and interpret content. On completion, it outputs a structured PDF, a Bitrix24-synced dataset, a Figma component JSON map, and a navigable website preview. Architecture principle: Determinism where it matters. AI where it adds value. Role: sole developer — architecture to deployment.
items.result: Briefing time reduced from hours to minutes. Every project now starts with a structured, design-ready brief. Figma receives the exact component map — no interpretation gaps, no information lost between client and designer.

items.title: Front-end BI & Management Dashboard
items.summary: A full-stack operational dashboard that turned gut-feel team management into data-driven decisions — built entirely by me, from architecture to deployment.
items.challenge: Managing a front-end team of 10+ developers without real-time visibility into deliveries, individual performance, QA quality, or process bottlenecks. Reporting was manual. Decisions were based on gut feeling.
items.solution: Designed and built a full management dashboard pulling live data from Bitrix24, a custom internal API, and a MySQL database. Tracks: deliveries, tasks, deadlines, QA scores, development time, revision history, attendance, individual goals, performance rankings, and custom reports. All charts built manually with SVG and CSS — no charting framework. Full ownership: design, front-end, back-end, DevOps.
items.result: The team now has full operational visibility. Performance reviews are objective and data-driven. Process bottlenecks are identified and resolved before they escalate. Leadership decisions are backed by real numbers, not estimates.

items.title: Clínica Balvedi
items.summary: Healthcare website built with React and Framer Motion — clean, accessible UI architected for a roadmap of SEO, AI chatbot, and conversion features.
items.challenge: A medical clinic needed a modern, trustworthy online presence that reflected quality care — and that could serve as the foundation for future lead-generation and AI-powered patient engagement features.
items.solution: Built with React 18, Vite, and Framer Motion for smooth, purposeful animations. Architecture is intentionally modular — every section designed to evolve. CI/CD via GitHub Actions ensures automated, consistent deployments from day one.
items.result: Phase 1 live. Roadmap includes advanced SEO (optimized for AI search), a lead-gen chatbot, interactive patient simulators, conversion tracking, and analytics-driven iteration. Designed to grow with the business.

about.label: About
about.title: The person behind the work
paragraphs: I work at the intersection of design and front-end development. Over 4 years, I've designed and built 400+ websites and landing pages — from quick-turnaround pages for local businesses to fully custom experiences for established brands. What I bring is the ability to take a project from briefing to launch without losing anything in translation between design and code.

My stack has evolved substantially. Today I build web applications with React, Next.js, Vue 3, and Nuxt — including internal tools, dashboards, and AI-powered platforms that I've built and currently maintain in production. That evolution hasn't changed how I think about craft: every pixel, interaction, and line of code is intentional.

Leading the front-end team at my company taught me that great engineering goes beyond writing good code. Quality standards, clear processes, and meaningful feedback loops are what make a team consistently deliver. I bring that perspective to everything I work on: I care about the outcome, not just the implementation.
